defects.TTL units: TTL is in seconds (600) but compared with a millisecond difference, so the cache expires after 600 ms instead of 10 minutes.
defects.no in-flight dedup: Concurrent getRate calls for the same currency all fetch; the spec allows at most one fetch in flight per currency.
defects.forEach async: totalEUR uses forEach with an async callback, so it returns before any line is added (returns 0).
defects.per-line rounding: Each line is rounded separately instead of rounding the total once, as the spec requires.
